purpose: Modeling reference concepts only; not meshes or implemented game assets

pizzaCutter.prompt: Create a production concept sheet for ONE new Roblox Wavebreaker weapon: an oversized PIZZA CUTTER. Use the attached existing weapon review as the strict art-style reference, especially its Frying Pan and Spatula: chunky low-poly geometry, clear facets, warm brown wooden handle, muted gray steel, flat simple colors, restrained soft shading, clean neutral gray studio backdrop. This must look made by the SAME asset artist, not a different game. Design a cool but recognizable manual pizza wheel cutter, large broad circular beveled steel wheel, simple charcoal axle bracket, two steel rivets on a short wooden grip and a hanging hole. No engine, no sci-fi, no ornate fantasy flourishes, no neon, no teeth/chainsaw, no face, no cheese or VFX obscuring geometry. Show one large three-quarter hero render left and smaller clean side and front views of EXACTLY the same design right, full silhouette and no cropping. The wheel is a separate rotating component with axle clearly understandable to a modeler. Maintain the reference's low-poly resolution and material simplicity. Minimal labels only: 'PIZZA CUTTER', 'SIDE', 'FRONT'. These are 2D model reference concepts, not a screenshot of game UI. Wide sheet.
